metadata.title: ESSAI SUR LA THÉORIE DES PROPORTIONS CHIMIQUES ET SUR L'INFLUENCE CHIMIQUE DE L'ÉLECTRICITÉ

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal unbracketed serifs characteristic of the late 18th and early 19th-century "Modern" style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was standard for academic and official printing in France during 1819.
